kicker: Words become voices; stones become notes on a stream.

voice.label: Text to voice
voice.art: A sentence beside a pond. As it is read aloud, sound waves rise like ink reeds, mirrored in the water.
voice.readAs: Read the sentence in the voice: {name}

langs.name: Tiếng Việt
langs.text: Sáng nay sương tan, mời bạn một chén trà.

langs.name: English
langs.text: The morning mist is gone, come have some tea.

voice.insight: Text-to-speech is AI reading text aloud: it learns how real people pause and stress words, so it sounds natural.
voice.detail: You can pick the voice, emotion and speed. Always listen before using it: AI may misread names and numbers.
voice.dubInsight: AI dubbing: the same voice, speaking another language.
voice.dubDetail: Ask a fluent speaker to check it: AI can get the meaning wrong, especially jokes and idioms.

consent.label: Voice cloning
consent.name: Lan
consent.copyAria: Use AI to copy Lan’s voice
consent.art: Two voice rings like two fingerprints: on the left, Lan’s real voice; on the right, the AI copy.
consent.insight: A voice belongs to its owner: always ask their permission, and clearly label it “AI voice”.

detail.text: A short recording is enough to fake a voice. A “relative” calls asking for money urgently? Don’t trust the voice: call back a number you know.

stream.label: Music stream
stream.art: A stream with five lines like a musical staff, bamboo on the bank. Each stone is a note that sings as it drifts past the bamboo.
stream.insight: Describe it in words — genre, mood, instruments — and AI writes the melody, harmony, sometimes even lyrics.
stream.detail: Each run usually gives a different track. Listen to a few, pick the one you like, then sharpen your description.
stream.rightsInsight: AI music learns from real music, so there are copyright disputes. Using it for business? Read the terms carefully.

rightsDetail.text: In 2024, major record labels sued Suno, alleging it used copyrighted music to train its AI.

quiz.q: You want AI to clone a coworker’s voice. What comes first?
options: Record them secretly so it sounds natural
Nothing, anyone’s voice is fair game
quiz.explain: A voice belongs to a real person: you need their consent, and when you post, label it as an AI voice.

summary: Using AI voices and music: ask permission, respect copyright, label it as AI.

ftc-voice-2023.title: Scammers use AI to enhance their family emergency schemes
ftc-voice-2023.publisher: U.S. Federal Trade Commission (FTC) · Consumer Alert
ftc-voice-2023.note: The FTC writes: scammers need only a short clip of a loved one’s voice; its advice is not to trust the voice, but to call back a number you know for sure.

riaa-suno-2024.title: Record Companies Bring Landmark Cases for Responsible AI Against Suno and Udio in Boston and New York Federal Courts, Respectively
riaa-suno-2024.note: Filed by Sony Music, Universal Music and Warner Records. These are allegations in a lawsuit, not a court ruling. Update (needs checking): Warner Music settled with Suno (Nov 2025); Universal and Sony were still pursuing the case per mid-2026 reports.
